Just for some context on why Dallas and Houston are massive opportunities for Tesla and the Robotaxi network:

When you look at the biggest metro areas in the U.S., two Texas cities are already in the top 5:

1️⃣ New York
2️⃣ Los Angeles
3️⃣ Chicago
4️⃣ Dallas–Fort Worth
5️⃣ Houston

That’s two of the top five right here in Texas. Perfect conditions for something like a Robotaxi network to scale quickly.

If Tesla executes well, Dallas and Houston aren’t just “good markets”… they could be some of the most important markets in the entire country.
